page.layout: Running head at top, page number at top right. Main text in one block: a table of consular years, each row with its Tiberius and Pontius Pilate years, the AUC year, and consul names with a bracket marked "coss."; below it two paragraphs of running text. Signature "G 3" at the foot.

main_text.l: Pontii Pilati . . . . 10. seu ultimus finiens in prin-cipio anni sequentis
main_text.p: Tiberius die 16 Martii mortuus Cajum accepit imperio fuccesforem Pilatus ex Judaeâ redux Romam appulit Tiberio jam mortuo.
§. 4. Dubium tamen est, & haud facile definitu, quâ anni formâ utatur Lucas ? an Tiberii xv numeret ab ipsius electionis die : num verò cum relatione ad an-nos

page.notes: Printed "Tiberu", "Pontu" and "fuccesforem"/"fuccessorem" are as printed; "Tiberu" and "Pontu" may be printer's errors. "Pontii Pilati .*." has an asterisk after the dot leaders, read as printed. Table cell separators are added by me; the printed page has columns aligned by spacing. The consul brackets are printed as "coss." and are transcribed as "coss.". The paragraph beginning "§. 4." continues past the page foot ("an-nos" completes at the line end). No catchword is printed. No marginal notes.
